text:
Maya R (partnerships): Quick heads-up — we're proposing a breaking change to the Partner SDK auth scheme. v2 will move to a structured bearer style: `Authorization: Redwood v2 <token>` and we plan to remove the legacy `X-API-Key` header. Target window: July 14 - rolling removal 4 weeks after deprecation announcement. Need alignment with marketplace listings and hardware SI integrators.

Owen K (platform): timeline ok. Do we have a deprecation header or warning plan for requests from older clients?

Maya R (partnerships): Yes — plan: 2-week soft deprecation with a verbose warning header, then hard reject. Warning header: `X-Redwood-Deprecation: legacy-key; will-be-removed=2027-07-28; migration=https://redwood.ai/partner-migration`. Also emit metric `partner.legacy_key_usage` to billing metrics.

Li W (eng-platform): We should provide an SDK shim for one minor release to keep partners afloat. Suggest publishing `redwood-partner-shim` that accepts `X-API-Key` and exchanges it server-side for the new format. Will need to sign-off on security review.

Sarah P (product): Also want an explicit semver plan in the partner docs: major bump for v2, changelog template, and a short migration checklist. Could marketing/partnerships sponsor a partner webinar + migration office hours? :calendar_spiral:

Arjun S (partner-success): I'll schedule webinars and identify top-10 partners to invite for early canary. Also collecting point-of-contact list — please add partner contacts to the shared spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/partners/migration-contacts

Maya R (partnerships): Owners & asks: (1) Li + eng-platform: publish shim + compatibility tests (owner: Li) (2) Sarah + Docs: migration guide + changelog template (owner: Sarah) (3) Arjun: partner comms and webinar (owner: Arjun) (4) Owen: rollout gating & metric dashboards (owner: Owen). Can each owner confirm ETA?

Li W (eng-platform): ETA for shim + tests: draft by 2027-06-20, release as 0.9.0, then 1.0.0 with v2. Will include CI job `partner-compat` that runs against sample partner manifests.

Owen K (platform): I'll add dashboards for `partner.legacy_key_usage` and SLO guardrails. Canary policy: 10% traffic to v1->v2 proxy for first week, rollback on >2% error delta.

Sarah P (product): Docs/guide ETA: 2027-06-18 for internal review, 2027-06-25 public. Will include code snippets and a migration checklist with commands. Example snippet for new header: ```http
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Redwood v2 <token>
Content-Type: application/json
```

Maya R (partnerships): Marketplace & partner distribution notes: update marketplace listings to call out required SDK version by removal date; coordinate press/announcement with partnerships team to avoid surprise for enterprise customers. Also need legal sign-off for deprecation notice copy.

Arjun S (partner-success): I will prepare partner email copy and a short FAQ. Will open a partner-only staging endpoint for testing: `https://staging-partners.redwood.ai/v2-migration` (credentials via Okta SAML invite).

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled for 2027-06-28 08:00 UTC for partners listed in the canary spreadsheet.

Maya R (partnerships): Last items — please add migration blockers to the runbook doc and tag `#urgent` for anything blocking canary. If anybody expects regulatory issues (on-prem / private deployments), flag now — we may extend the grace period. Thanks all — propose a quick sync Thu 09:30 to lock timelines. :thumbsup:
